name: Adyen
description: Adyen is an enterprise fintech platform offering "one platform for payments, data, and financial products," enabling large businesses to accept payments, send payouts, and launch financial services through a single API.
best_for: Large enterprises and platforms across retail, travel/hospitality, SaaS marketplaces, financial services, and digital media that need global scale, complex payment workflows, and consolidated financial operations.
features: Payment acceptance across 150+ currencies and 200+ local payment methods
Global payouts and in-person point-of-sale payments on a single API
99.999% historical platform uptime backed by US, UK, and EU banking licenses
Built-in fraud reduction and conversion-optimization tooling
Embedded finance capabilities: accounts, card issuing, and capital

alternatives.name: Stripe
alternatives.description: A payments and financial-infrastructure API for accepting payments and managing billing/subscriptions.
alternatives.best_for: Businesses of any size that need to process payments and manage billing/subscriptions.

alternatives.name: Plaid
alternatives.description: Connects applications to bank accounts and financial data, often used alongside payment processors for verification.
alternatives.best_for: Companies building fintech products that need to verify bank accounts or access financial data.
